title: EU: long arrival delay
conditions: publicly available fare or rewards ticket
claimDeadline: Not adjudicated: verify the competent jurisdiction and current limitation rules.
paraphrase: Fixed compensation can arise at three hours final-arrival delay, subject to a proven extraordinary-circumstances defense. Care uses departure delay, not arrival delay.

title: EU: cancellation notice and rerouting
conditions: publicly available fare or rewards ticket
claimDeadline: Not adjudicated: verify the competent jurisdiction and current limitation rules.
paraphrase: Cancellation gives refund/rerouting and assistance. Fixed compensation depends on notice, offered rerouting, and any proven extraordinary-circumstances defense.

title: EU: involuntary denied boarding
conditions: publicly available fare or rewards ticket
claimDeadline: Not adjudicated: verify the competent jurisdiction and current limitation rules.
paraphrase: Involuntary denial when boarding conditions are met carries compensation and refund/rerouting plus assistance. Reasonable health, safety and documentation refusals are separate.

title: EU: meals, communications, overnight care
conditions: publicly available fare or rewards ticket
claimDeadline: Not adjudicated: verify the competent jurisdiction and current limitation rules.
paraphrase: Departure delay of two, three or four hours depending on distance triggers meals and communications. Hotel and transport apply where an overnight stay becomes necessary. Extraordinary circumstances do not erase the care duty.

title: EU: refund choice
conditions: publicly available fare or rewards ticket
claimDeadline: Not adjudicated: verify the competent jurisdiction and current limitation rules.
paraphrase: Cancellation or involuntary denied boarding brings a choice of reimbursement or rerouting. A departure delay of at least five hours brings reimbursement when the passenger abandons the journey.

conditions: publicly available fare or rewards ticket
claimDeadline: Not adjudicated: verify the competent jurisdiction and current limitation rules.
paraphrase: Use the regulation for exact two-hour domestic and four-hour international boundaries: at the boundary, the higher band applies. The schedule of offered alternate transport matters, not only actual arrival.

title: US: arrival delay and refund
conditions: publicly available fare or rewards ticket
claimDeadline: Not adjudicated: verify the competent jurisdiction and current limitation rules.
paraphrase: Federal law does not generally require fixed delay/cancellation compensation. Refunds apply to cancellations or significant schedule changes when travel and alternative benefits are declined; late-arrival thresholds are three hours domestic and six hours international. Airline commitments can add rights.

title: Sturgeon: long arrival delays
holding: The official court announcement reports compensation at three hours or more, subject to extraordinary circumstances. A technical defect requires assessment of its nature and control.

title: Nelson: long-delay approach confirmed
holding: The official court announcement confirms the Sturgeon treatment of three-hour final-arrival delay and the extraordinary-circumstances defense.
